text:
This fun mashup combines the iconic flavors of a classic double-decker burger with a crispy, cheesy homemade pizza.
Prep: 20 min | Cook: 15 min
Steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C) and lightly grease a baking sheet with optional cooking oil.
2. In a skillet over medium-high heat, brown 1.0 pound ground beef with optional salt and pepper until fully cooked, then drain the grease; cook 5.0 piece bacon in a separate pan until crispy, then chop into bite-sized bits.
3. Roll out the 1.0 pizza crust onto the baking sheet and pre-bake for 5 minutes if instructed by your crust package.
4. Spread half of the 14.0 ounce thousand island dressing and half of the 8.0 ounce mustard evenly over the crust to serve as the sauce.
5. Evenly layer the cooked ground beef and crumbled bacon over the sauce, then top with 3.0 cup cheddar cheese.
6. Bake in the oven for 10 to 12 minutes until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbling.
7. Remove the pizza from the oven and top with 3.0 cup lettuce, 2.0 cup diced tomato, and 0.75 cup chopped dill pickle.
8. Drizzle the remaining thousand island dressing and mustard over the fresh toppings before slicing into 6 servings.
Tips:
- Shred the lettuce thinly and dice the pickles and tomatoes finely to make slicing the pizza easy.
- Drain the cooked ground beef and bacon thoroughly so the pizza crust does not get soggy.
- Add the cold toppings immediately before serving so the lettuce stays crisp and refreshing.
